review_notes: I reviewed all 41 lines of Mathlib/Data/Fintype/Sigma.lean. The four Set.biUnion/biInter_finsetSigma_univ lemmas and their primed versions are each proved by a single `aesop` call. The only variation is the local `Sigma.forall` simp attribute on one of them. The two instances and the final `rfl` lemma are one-liners and share no proof steps. This is not nontrivial reasoning repeated across proofs. A shared lemma would add API and wouldn't make anything clearer. I did not look for external duplicates, since the rubric concerns repetition within proofs. I'm fairly confident that nothing here meets the rubric.
